stem.text: A crane is being used to lift containers off a ship. One container has a mass of $14\,000\,\text{kg}$ and is being lifted vertically with a speed of $3.2\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
The electric motor being used to supply the power to lift the container is using a current of $240\,\text{A}$ at a potential difference of $2200\,\text{V}$.
What is the efficiency of the system?
